title: White House Launches 2027 Student AI Challenge, New School Readiness Seal
key_facts: First Lady Melania Trump launched the 2027 Presidential Super Intelligence (SI) Challenge on 13 Oct 2026
The administration recently began calling AI "super intelligence"; Trump directed the executive branch to use the term
It is a competition for K-12 students and educators; the earlier AI Challenge drew more than 20,000 students
Registration runs from 13 Oct to 18 Dec 2026; projects are due 23 Dec 2026; national championship in Washington in June 2027
A new First Lady Seal of SI Readiness recognises schools that meet milestones in school, classroom, workforce and community readiness
Milestones include policies for responsible use, student privacy and security, and teacher development
Schools have until 30 Apr 2027 to submit evidence; recipients are to be announced by 28 May
quote_evidence: First Lady Melania Trump launched the 2027 Presidential Super Intelligence (SI) Challenge on Oct. 13.
Schools have until April 30, 2027, to submit evidence of completed milestones.
why_it_matters_hint: A White House programme pushes schools and students toward AI skills and sets criteria for school readiness.
notes: Read in full. Quotes attributed to "Trump" in the article without a first name; taken as the First Lady in context but unclear, so no quote used.
